## Need an option to create Buyer Block booking linked indents and also need material allocation (MRL) to linked OCs (352391 )

### Business Requirement:
Enable tracking and procurement of materials against Buyer Block Bookings so that procurement activities can be linked, monitored, and validated against buyer-provided block booking commitments.

### Problems Encountered:
Previously, there was no structured mechanism to link procurement and adhoc indents directly with Buyer Block Bookings, resulting in limited traceability and manual tracking.

### Type: New Development

### Role / Target Audience: Merchandising Department

### Solution:
Introduced enhancements to Buyer Block Booking and Adhoc Indent modules to allow linking of block bookings with procurement indents. Added new fields, validations, and automated material allocation logic to ensure accurate tracking and fulfillment. Added new 'Booking Ref' field in Buyer Block Booking header (configurable via Screen Layout).
Introduced 'Material Details' section in Buyer Block Booking with article-level controls.
Added new Indent Type'Buyer Block Booking'. Enabled linking of Buyer Block Booking lines to Adhoc Indents.



For Auto allocation
Create a BBB---Attach materials---created a Adhoc indent (of created BBB)---Fulfill adhoc indent----GRN
Create a Oc ---attach the BBB ---Create OC kinked Indent ---Auto allocation of SAME SKU LEVEL will be seen
